envelope.description: Make the JetBrains Workflows reader list an ISSUE-anchored work item

body.title: Make the JetBrains Workflows reader list an ISSUE-anchored work item
body.summary: In jetbrains-plugin/src/main/kotlin/ai/insors/insrc/jetbrains/workflow/WorkflowChainReader.kt, readDir also enumerates ISSUE-<hash>.json for hashes that have no DEF-<hash>.json and projects each as a chain entry: define mark from the ISSUE's meta.approvedAt and meta.rejectedAt, hld absent, one implied story s1 titled with the ISSUE body title with hasLld and approved read from LLD-<hash>-s1.json and never stale, zero amendments, and a plain hint (Approve issue, Re-run issue, Design story s1, Approve LLD for s1, Chain complete) that never names an HLD, amendment or stale step. WorkflowChainDto gains a defaulted definitionKind field so existing callers compile unchanged. A hash with both a DEF and an ISSUE is listed once, as the DEF; a malformed ISSUE contributes nothing. Read-only, no socket, never throws. DEF entries and their hints are unchanged. Add the tests to WorkflowChainReaderTest.kt.
acceptanceChecks: an ISSUE-only hash is listed once with definitionKind issue, the implied story s1 and no HLD
the ISSUE hint follows Approve issue, Re-run issue, Design story s1, Approve LLD for s1, Chain complete and never names an HLD, amendment or stale step
a hash with both a DEF and an ISSUE is listed once, as the DEF
a malformed ISSUE file contributes nothing and does not throw
the existing DEF-anchored WorkflowChainReaderTest cases and WorkflowsPageTest pass unchanged

tests.name: WorkflowChainReaderTest.kt: readAll lists an ISSUE-anchored hash with the implied story s1 and no HLD
WorkflowChainReaderTest.kt: nextActionHint for an ISSUE-anchored entry follows approve issue, design story, approve LLD, chain complete
WorkflowChainReaderTest.kt: readAll lists a hash with both a DEF and an ISSUE once, as the DEF
WorkflowChainReaderTest.kt: readAll swallows a malformed ISSUE file without throwing
